title: ID0371853-DC/SI-D/AT[1jbRCQ] - LOGO downgrade
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
Outlets out of order
Root cause:
LOGO update from factory is wrong v4.0 → needs to be v2.7.0
Solution:
Downgrade locally the FW version from 4.0 to 2.7.0
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
Keyword:
Wrong LOGO FW from factory

additional_info.subject: ID0371853-DC/SI-D/AT[1jbRCQ] - LOGO downgrade CRM:00315001656
additional_info.body:
Hello Johannes,
After some help from L3 colleague, we were able to bring the charger back to v3.2.8 and it is confirmed to be charging.
For the LOGO downgrade please bring the micro-SD card with the v2.7.0 and perform the downgrade.
This needs to be done in site since there is no possibility to update the LOGO remotely. If you have any doubts or questions you know where to reach me.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
